# heic-to 1.6.7

Unmodified IIFE distribution from the official npm package, LGPL-3.0-or-later.
Used as a separate, replaceable library only if native HEIC/HEIF decoding fails.
The converter runs locally and does not send images to an external service.

- Project and corresponding source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
- Original source package (including JS glue and build instructions): https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
- libheif 1.23.7 source and build scripts: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.7
- libde265 1.0.16 source: https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16
- LGPL and GPL license texts are included alongside this file.

The application loads the standalone script dynamically. It can be replaced
with a compatible build without rebuilding or changing the application code.

SHA-256 of the unmodified distributed script: 99e4d1226915db5ac870b370bbd086a347f1f011d022d48fcf6bc345c72634b3
